body:
## Summary

Qwen3-Omni's streaming code2wav decodes every window from zero state: a later window decodes up to 25 frames of left context again to output 10 new frames.

The 25-frame context cuts the code2wav transformer's 72-frame attention window, so the streamed audio is not the audio of the whole utterance: against HF's fp32 decode of the whole utterance, the streamed windows lose 9 to 16 dB of SNR.

This PR keeps each stream's decoder state between windows in a slot of a codec state pool. A window decodes only its new frames, every frame attends over its full window, and the streamed audio equals the whole-utterance decode up to bf16 rounding.

Note: three follow-up PRs build on this pool and land after it: the rope kernel stores each layer's K/V and FA3 attends through the ring's page table; Triton kernels exchange conv histories and overlaps in place; each conv's producer writes straight into the next conv's input, its bias fused into SnakeBeta. On this PR's windows they take a 1-row first window from 1511 to 1190 us (main's is 1323 us) and an 8-row later window from 4266 to 2927 us.

## Mechanism

A stream takes a slot when its first codes arrive and returns it when it ends. A stream that finds no free slot decodes windows with left context, as before. Every decode runs on the code2wav serving thread's one stream, so a reused slot's new stream decodes after its previous one; a decode's slot ids reach the device from pinned host memory without a host sync.

A slot holds, per transformer layer, a K/V ring of the 71 retained frames plus one window; every causal conv's history; every transposed conv's overlap; and the stream's frame position.

Transformer: the existing rope kernel rotates q and k at the frames' positions in the stream, the new K/V go into the ring, and a later window attends over its ring window with SDPA and a sliding-window mask. The rope table covers the talker's context, since a slot's positions are positions in the stream.

Conv stack: each causal conv reads its history from the slot in front of the new frames and stores the newest history back; each transposed conv adds the slot's overlap and stores the samples the next frames still add to. The transposed conv's bias is added after the overlap, so overlapping samples carry it once.

CUDA graphs are captured per row count for a stream's first window and for a later one, each captured row on its own scratch slot. Stateless window graphs are captured at one row only, since only a stream without a slot decodes them.

A stream that ends before its first window decodes its frames as one stateless window.

## Changes

`sglang_omni/models/qwen3_omni/components/codec_state_pool.py`: `CodecStatePool` (the stream slots' free list, history and overlap pools, per-layer K/V rings, capture scratch slots, frame positions), `CodecStateSpec` and the ring addresses.

`sglang_omni/models/qwen3_omni/components/incremental_codec.py`: the code2wav conv stack on the pool and its state layout.

`sglang_omni/models/qwen3_omni/components/code2wav.py`: `Qwen3OmniIncrementalCodec` and the fused transformer's slot forward, which shares each layer's qkv, attention and output with the window forward; the rope table sized by the caller.

`sglang_omni/models/qwen3_omni/components/code2wav_cuda_graph.py`, `code2wav_scheduler.py`: first and later window graphs per row count, the slot claimed with a stream's first codes.

`sglang_omni/models/qwen3_omni/config.py`, `stages.py`: the talker takes its running request cap from the pipeline config, and code2wav keeps one slot per stream the talkers can run, following an engine or factory override of that cap.

## Results

Qwen3-Omni colocated bf16 on H200, SeedTTS EN streamed with voice clone, full corpus (1088 requests), main against this PR at the same time on two cards, swapped each round; the mean of four rounds.

| metric | main | this PR | change |
|---|---|---|---|
| c16 QPS | 11.929 | 12.060 | +1.1 % |
| c16 RTF | 0.3684 | 0.3642 | -1.1 % |
| c16 latency median / p95 / p99 (s) | 1.324 / 1.961 / 2.281 | 1.304 / 1.948 / 2.274 | -1.5 / -0.6 / -0.3 % |
| c16 first audio mean (ms) | 559.4 | 548.8 | -1.9 % |
| c64 QPS | 15.687 | 16.130 | +2.8 % |
| c64 RTF | 1.1487 | 1.1084 | -3.5 % |
| c64 latency median / p95 / p99 (s) | 4.043 / 5.197 / 5.814 | 3.915 / 5.056 / 5.735 | -3.1 / -2.7 / -1.4 % |
| c64 first audio mean (ms) | 2476.2 | 2405.1 | -2.9 % |
| c1 RTF | 0.1226 | 0.1220 | -0.5 % |
| c16 WER below 50 % | 1.68 % | 1.70 % | +0.02 pt |
| c16 SIM | 6.43 | 6.51 | +0.08 |
| peak card memory (MiB) | 130154 | 129720 | -434 |

Seeded c1, paired by prompt over the four rounds: request latency -0.08 ms. A stream's first window also writes the stream's state (K/V into the ring, every conv history and overlap), which adds 0.25 ms to first audio, measured per request at host timestamps on both cards; every later window is cheaper (table below).

SNR against HF's fp32 decode of the whole utterance, real checkpoint, random valid codes:

| frames | HF bf16 | whole forward | this PR's slots | main's windows |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 46 | 33.7 dB | 33.7 dB | 34.0 dB | 25.2 dB |
| 120 | 36.0 dB | 35.9 dB | 35.9 dB | 20.4 dB |
| 290 | 34.8 dB | 34.9 dB | 34.9 dB | 18.9 dB |

code2wav GPU time per window (one CUDA graph replay, median of 20):

| window | 1 row | 8 rows |
|---|---|---|
| main's first window (10 frames) | 1323.0 us | 3656.3 us |
| main's later window (35 frames) | 2026.9 us | 10777.5 us |
| this PR's first window | 1509.7 us | 3992.0 us |
| this PR's later window | 1675.7 us | 4255.3 us |

## Tests

Slot decodes split any way keep the whole forward's fp32 error bound; a stream past the code2wav config's positions decodes correctly; a reused slot decodes a new stream bit for bit as a fresh pool; rows at different stream positions in one decode keep their own streams; the scheduler's eager and graph paths equal direct slot decodes; a stream takes its slot with its first codes and abort returns it; a stream shorter than its first window decodes without slot state; a full pool hands out no slot until one is released; the pool zeroes only the capture slots; ring addresses list each window in position order on distinct rows; code2wav's slot count follows the talker's cap through the pipeline default, a factory override and an engine override, and the talker runs its cap unless the engine overrides it.
title: [Qwen3-Omni] Decode streamed code2wav from each stream's kept state
